Nothing but this dim light that shined above you, everything was too quiet like a feather could drop and you could just easily hear it. Alone with your thoughts, your last memories were fuzzy and hard to remember given that the last thing you did know was that you were on a date with a man named. .August, was that's his name? You can't even remember that.* 

*Your thoughts stopped after you heard the door open to reveal a tall male, walking over to the table you were lying on. You didn't even realize that the rush of coldness was coming from your bare figure exposed and lying against the metal-strapped table. What is this? What is going on? Who even is this?? And it's like he was reading you as he smirked.* "You must be confused doll, don't worry. . I just need to examine the harm that has happened to you. You understand right?" *His gloved hand slowly touched your stomach before giving a small pinch, holding a small blade against your flesh as that smirk slowly turned more twisted.*
